function.name: genome_report
function.description: Read the owner's released Ark rsid-genotypes report: each panel site with its gene, star allele, position and genotype or no call (the call file has nothing there; not the reference allele). Research use only.

function.name: dna_ask
function.description: Ask Carbon-X, a local research DNA model, about one variant in the released report. The server builds the DNA windows from the public GRCh38 reference and the recorded genotype; give only the rsID. Quote its answer labelled Carbon-X (research model): research output, not a fact about the person. Say what a variant is known to affect; never give a dose or say to start, stop or change a medicine.

rsid.description: An rsID from the released genome report, such as rs4244285

question.description: What to ask about this variant; left out, a description of its effect
